subject: Invoice onboarding: preferred channel and minimal field guardrails
messages:
From: aditya_rao
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearwater-supplies.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz, monica_patel
Date: 2026-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice channel and minimal required fields

Hi Liam,

Thanks for moving forward with Redwood. Quick one to make vendor setup smooth on our side: do you prefer submitting invoices via our portal or sent to accounts@redwood-invoice.com (email)? Either is fine, but we have different minimal validation rules depending on the channel and want to share the exact expectations up front so you don't hit rejections.

Key requirements we enforce by channel:
- Portal: structured CSV upload or single PDF per invoice. System validates PO number, total amount, and vendor tax ID before ingest.
- Email: attachments accepted (PDF/CSV) but subject line must include PO#; we also require line-item CSV or a clearly readable PDF (see attached sample).

Attached is our vendor onboarding form and a sample invoice template (CSV). Can you confirm:
1) your preferred submission channel,
2) whether you can include a PO number in the subject for email submissions, and
3) any internal invoice-field differences we should map (e.g., cost center, department)?

If you prefer portal, we can send an invite today; if email, we'll provide the subject convention and example headers to avoid manual rework.

Thanks — we want this to be low-friction.

—Aditya Rao
Vendor Enablement (Redwood Inference)
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: sample_invoice_template.csv (text/csv)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearwater-supplies.com>
To: aditya_rao, vanessa_ortiz
Date: 2026-09-08T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice channel and minimal required fields

Hi Aditya,

Thanks — quick answers:
1) We'd prefer email for the first 60 days while our accounting team finishes ERP cutover; after that we can evaluate portal upload.
2) Yes, we can put the PO number in the subject. We'll use the format: PO-XXXXX (example: PO-123456).
3) Our invoices include an internal cost center code (CCY-####) on a separate line. If that can map to Redwood's cost_center field, that would be ideal.

I'll attach a sample invoice in PDF so you can see layout (we typically include multiple small line items). If you have any automated tolerance rules for rounding or tax lines, please flag them — our invoices sometimes include per-line taxes.

Attached: clearwater_invoice_example.pdf

Best,
Liam
Accounts Payable, Clearwater Supplies
accounts@clearwater-supplies.com
[Attachment: clearwater_invoice_example.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: aditya_rao
To: vanessa_ortiz, monica_patel
Date: 2026-09-08T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding: invoice channel and minimal required fields

Vanessa / Monica — forwarding Liam's responses. Key operational notes for onboarding:

- Channel: Email-first (for 60 days), then portal invite. We need to ensure email subject parsing for PO- pattern. I'll ask our ingest team to accept both 'PO-123456' and plain digits (123456) to be tolerant.
- Cost center: Clearwater uses a separate line 'CCY-####' — map to our cost_center optional field; if missing, mark voucher as 'cost_center: unknown' and route to AP queue for manual mapping.
- Taxes: their invoices may have per-line tax; our parser currently supports a single tax column or per-line tax if present in CSV. For PDFs we'll fallback to OCR and mark as manual review if per-line taxes are ambiguous.

Action items: 
- Vanessa: please create an AP intake ticket with the 'email-first' acceptance rule and include example subject regex (PO[- ]?\d{4,7}).
- Monica: attach the vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf to the vendor record and create a mapping for cost_center -> cc_field in the ledger.

I'm attaching the sample CSV we'll send to the vendor with explicit column headers (InvoiceDate, InvoiceNumber, PO, LineDescription, Quantity, UnitPrice, LineTax, CostCenter). If either of you wants to tweak the header names before I send, flag it quickly.

Thanks,
Aditya

From: vanessa_ortiz
To: aditya_rao, monica_patel, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearwater-supplies.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice channel and minimal required fields

Hi Liam — welcome on board. Quick confirmation and next steps from Redwood side: 

1) We'll accept email submissions to accounts@redwood-invoice.com with subject containing PO- or digits. Please use: Subject: Invoice PO-123456 | Redwood P.O. 2026-0811 if possible. This helps automated matching.
2) For cost centers: include CCY-#### on the invoice body; we'll auto-map to cost_center when pattern matched. If not present we'll ping you for clarification during the 60-day period.
3) We can tolerate per-line tax columns; for PDFs we'll do OCR and fallback to manual review only if tax lines fail to parse.

I'll kick off the portal invite workflow now so you see the portal UI. You'll get: 1) vendor onboarding form (please fill and sign), 2) CSV template, and 3) a short onboarding checklist. I've attached the onboarding form for reference (we'll also push DocuSign to the email you provided).

Delivery timeline: portal invite within 24 hours; in the meantime please send invoices to accounts@redwood-invoice.com using the subject convention above so we can begin ingest.

Thanks — looking forward to smooth ops.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Revenue Operations (Redwood Inference)
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]
